englishText: O Allah, One may call up, prepare,
ready oneself, and stand prepared
for purpose of coming to a creature
in the hope of gaining his aid
and asking for his gift and present.
As for myself, to You—O my Lord—I make my preparations and readiness
hoping for Your pardon
and asking for Your gift and present.
So, (please) do not disappoint my entreaty.

arabicText: يَا مَنْ لاَ يَخِيبُ عَلَيْهِ سَائِلٌ
englishText: O He Who never disappoints His beseechers
and Whose prizes never decrease His ample-giving!

arabicText: فَإنّي لَمْ آتِكَ ثِقَةً بِعَمَلٍ صَالِحٍ عَمِلْتُهُ
englishText: I have not come to You with confidence of a righteous deed that I have done
nor have I had any hope in a grant of any creature.

arabicText: اتَيْتُكَ مُقِرّاً عَلَىٰ نَفْسِي بِٱلإسَاءَةِ وَٱلظُّلْمِ
englishText: Rather, I have come to You professing myself to be evildoer and transgressor

arabicText: مُعْتَرِفاً بِانْ لاَ حُجَّةَ لِي وَلاَ عُذْرَ
englishText: and confessing that I lack any pretext or excuse.
I have come to You hoping for Your great pardon
due to which You have pardoned the wrongdoers.

arabicText: فَلَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ طُولُ عُكُوفِهِمْ عَلِي عَظِيمِ ٱلْجُرْمِ
englishText: Hence, their long-lasting retirement to their grave offenses has not prevented You
from turning to them with mercy.
O He Whose mercy is huge
and Whose pardon is great;

arabicText: يَا عَظيـمُ يَا عَظيـمُ يَا عَظيـمُ
englishText: O All-great, O All-great, O All-great;
nothing can repel Your rage except Your forbearance

arabicText: وَلاَ يُنْجِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ إِلاَّ ٱلتَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ
englishText: and nothing can save from Your wrath except imploring earnestly to You.
So, my God, (please) grant me a relief

arabicText: بِٱلْقُدْرَةِ ٱلَّتِي تُحْيِي بِهَا مَيْتَ ٱلْبِلاَدِ
englishText: in the name of the power through which You restore to life the derelict lands,

arabicText: وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي غَمّاً حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَجِيبَ لِي
englishText: and do not cause me to perish out of grief until You respond to me
and show me signs of Your response to my prayers.

arabicText: وَاذِقْنِي طَعْمَ ٱلْعَافِيَةِ إلَىٰ مُنَتَهَىٰ اجَلِي
englishText: (please) Make me taste the flavor of wellbeing up to the end of my lifetime,
do not make my enemies gloat over me,
do not give them a hand over me,
and do not make them control over me.

arabicText: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِي
englishText: O Allah, If You humiliate me, who can then exalt me?

arabicText: وَإِنْ رَفَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَضَعُنِي
englishText: And if You exalt me, who can then humiliate me?

arabicText: وَإِنْ اهْلَكْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا ٱلَّذِي يَعْرِضُ لَكَ فِي عَبْدِكَ
englishText: If You annihilate me, who can then interfere before You concerning the affair of me—Your slave
or who can intercede to ask You about it?

arabicText: وَقَدْ عَلِمْتُ انَّهُ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ
englishText: I have already known for sure that Your decrees are devoid of injustice
and Your punishment does not count on immediateness.
Verily, immediateness is the work of him who fears lest he may miss,
and only do the weak need injustice.

arabicText: وَقَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا إِلٰهِي عَنْ ذٰلِكَ عُلُوّاً كَبِيراً
englishText: As for You, O my God, You are too exalted to be so—Exalted and Great You are beyond all measure!
O Allah, I take refuge in You; so, (please) have protection upon me!
I call for Your safekeeping; so, (please) keep me under Your security!
I appeal for Your sustenance; so, (please) provide me with sustenance!
I put trust in You; so, (please) keep me under Your supervision!
I call for Your aid against my enemy; so, (please) grant me support!
I seek Your assistance; so, (please) assist me!
I ask for Your forgiveness; so, (please) forgive me.
So, respond! Respond! Respond!
